response.original_title: The Week That Shook the World
response.overview: The failed August 1991 coup d'état against Soviet President Mikhail Gorbachev by hardliners is examined in ABC News' special coverage The Week That Shook The World: The Soviet Coup. The three-day crisis collapsed amid public resistance and a lack of full military support, ultimately accelerating the dissolution of the Soviet Union. Watch the special coverage at ABC News.
